nonblocking.title: STATUS.md is internally stale (new evidence)
nonblocking.evidence: STATUS.md:28 (G12 row) says the review of cec6701 "returned SHIP with N27 and N28, both since fixed", and STATUS.md:29 (G13 row) speaks of "the commit that fixes N27 and N28", but the review of faf22c5 resolved only N28's ledger part and kept N28 open for the meta.json part (see N28 below), which 73702ee does not touch. STATUS.md is allowed drift, so correcting it does not invalidate this review.

nonblocking.title: The pre-push claim overstates the script (re-raised: the fixed wording regressed)
nonblocking.evidence: README.md:327-329 says "Before a push, `tools/prepush.sh` runs `make setup` and `make ci` on a fresh clone, once for each of Python 3.11 and 3.12." tools/prepush.sh:14 runs make setup and make ci once, on the Makefile's `PY ?= 3.11` (Makefile:5) unless the caller sets PY; the 3.12 leg is a second run of the script (the main session's prepush-<sha>-311.log and -312.log). e8ee5de fixed exactly this sentence for N3 ("... on a fresh clone with one Python version; it is run once for each of Python 3.11 and 3.12"), and fc89cc9 (2026-11-25, the README rewrite) shortened it so that the script is again credited with both runs. The practice is real (both legs passed for 73702ee); the sentence is not exact. A corrected sentence in a results document needs a CORRECTIONS.md entry.

nonblocking.title: The review files drift by design (remaining part)
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: docs/REVIEW_LOG.md is not in ALLOWED_DRIFT (tools/review.py:34), and validate() (tools/review.py:84-87) requires every non-blocking id of a review to be listed there at HEAD (D10). This review reviews HEAD and raises no id the log lacks, so tools/review.py --validate-only accepts it for 73702ee and for any commit that differs from 73702ee only in artifacts/review/, STATUS.md, or docs/LOG.md. Recording the N2 or N3 evidence in docs/REVIEW_LOG.md, or correcting README.md for N3, changes a file outside ALLOWED_DRIFT and then needs another review; section 10.6 step 2 commits only artifacts/review/.

nonblocking.title: The gates do not yet require the hidden checkout and verified snapshot for E1 and E4 runs (remaining part)
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged (tools/ship_check.py has not changed since cec6701): only G6 requires snapshot_verified and sandbox.checkout_hidden, for a run a plan amendment added (tools/ship_check.py:3625, 3634); G7 and G9 do not, and ran_committed_code (tools/ship_check.py:4960) still accepts a self-declared snapshot_of equal to git_sha. Fix before E1.

nonblocking.title: docs/CLAIM_TYPES.md and the checker disagree on tests_added (remaining part)
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: check_tests_added (src/receipts/verify/checkers.py:241) supports any added test file, while docs/CLAIM_TYPES.md:15 requires the test count to rise; README.md (Limitations) and docs/REPORT.md section 7.4 disclose the error, and the banked verdicts show it (py-email-tests and py-slugify-tests: tests_added supported). Align the two before E0 writers and adjudicators label truth.

nonblocking.title: G5 does not read the E0 blindness audit
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: tools/ship_check.py has no reference to blindness (grep count 0); only tools/e0.py merge enforces that the seeded-report writers never saw src/receipts/claims/.

nonblocking.title: The E1 analysis does not implement the draft's Held-out attempts rule
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: prereg/0001-e1-main-study.md says the analyses record the evaluation's attempt number and list every attempt when it is not the first; src/receipts/study/results.py reads neither artifacts/e0/heldout_attempts.jsonl nor the attempt number. Fix before the freeze.

nonblocking.title: The smoke summary's provenance names neither the command that wrote it nor a commit that holds its inputs
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: artifacts/exploratory/smoke_outcomes.json provenance.command is "python tools/smoke_outcomes.py --out /tmp/tmpkxf73ed3/smoke_outcomes.json", and git_sha is 3cdda50, whose tree lacks the D71 run first committed in 922cc0d. All 40 input hashes match the banked run.json files (recomputed), and freshness ignores both keys by design (D56).

nonblocking.title: The re-derivations rest on tool code that no gate binds
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: check_rederived (tools/ship_check.py:4081) trusts the exit status of the clone's tools/bank_study.py --check, rescored_heldout (2760) the tools/e0.py recheck wrapper, and check_derivation (4119) receipts.report.derived, tools/analyze.py, tools/analyze_e4.py, and tools/run_judges.py; none is held unchanged since a freeze (the D57 residual).

nonblocking.title: Documentation statements that are not exact (remaining part)
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged at 73702ee: (m) docs/REPORT.md:589 says each CORRECTIONS.md entry "names the file and section it corrects", but CORRECTIONS.md:134 ("The headline figure") names neither a file nor a section, and CORRECTIONS.md:46 and :72 name files but no section; (n) src/receipts/__init__.py:1 still says "check every claim in a coding agent's final report", the wording CORRECTIONS.md corrected in pyproject.toml, README.md, docs/REPORT.md, and docs/BENCH.md (receipts checks the claims its extractor finds).

nonblocking.title: ship_check accepts a shallow clone outside G11 (remaining part)
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: only tools/prereg.py:471-475 refuses a shallow clone; ship_check's pre-phase does not, so the history checks of G5, G6, G7, and G9 (for example require_unchanged_runs) would walk truncated history in one. This checkout has its full history (git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository: false; 256 commits to HEAD).

nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: heldout_attempt (tools/ship_check.py:2660) compares earlier held-out attempts by instrument files only; task_requirements (src/receipts/evaluation/e0.py:2501) reads requirement texts at HEAD, outside SCORING_PATHS (e0.py:86), and log_attempt (e0.py:2696) records neither requirement digests nor claim-type counts. Fix before any held-out scoring (the open item of D69).

nonblocking.title: The demo card's labels come from each fixture's meta.json, which nothing compares with the banked run (remaining part)
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: tests/repo_tools/test_record_demo.py test_every_demo_fixture_is_its_banked_run_unchanged compares only ledger.jsonl and its recorded SHA-256; the card's task, agent, model, and "recorded from ... (run at <sha>)" lines come from meta.json (tools/demo.py:47-48), which no test or gate compares with the banked run.json. They agree today: for each of the three fixtures, meta.json equals record_demo.fixture_meta(<banked run>) and the ledger is byte-identical to the banked one.

resolved: B9: 73702ee makes each fake sandbox's private TMPDIR with tempfile.mkdtemp, outside the workspace and its parent, and removes it with weakref.finalize when the sandbox goes (tests/bench/fakes.py:85-86); tests/bench/test_fakes.py:12-26 checks that commands see that directory as TMPDIR, that it is not the host temp directory, that nothing lands in or beside the workspace, and that it is gone once the sandbox is collected. tests/bench/test_validate.py::test_workspaces_are_removed_by_default passes: in the fast check on a fresh clone (4479 passed, 75 deselected; G1 and G3 PASS) and in a scratch clone with its own environment (tests/bench/test_fakes.py and tests/bench/test_validate.py with slow tests: 64 passed). Both prepush legs for 73702ee print PREPUSH: PASS (311 exit 0, 312 exit 0). So STATUS.md:17 and :19, README.md:312-313, and docs/REPORT.md:674-679 are true at 73702ee.

N27 (kept fixed by the B9 fix): the four slow test_pilot_task_validates exemplars, pilot-py-bizdays among them, pass in the scratch clone; a task's pytest now uses <private dir>/pytest-of-<user>, never the host's /tmp/pytest-of-<user>; no /tmp/receipts-fake-tmp-* directory remained after that run or after the two prepush legs.

# Independent review of 73702ee (gate G12)

Reviewed commit: 73702ee309638a87e9394d4a8e4d5c34716b8ad7 (branch claude/sweet-newton-r3x6t3; origin/main and the session branch on origin point to it). Previous review: faf22c51878296371a052c36b8966cbcf2255750 (BLOCK on B9). The working tree was clean; only committed state was examined.

## Scope

`git log faf22c5..73702ee`: c98c1a2 banks the review of faf22c5 (artifacts/review/latest.json, STATUS.md's G12 row, and a docs/REVIEW_LOG.md section for B9); 73702ee fixes B9 in tests/bench/fakes.py and tests/bench/test_fakes.py. Since cec6701, the last SHIP review, nothing under src/, tools/, prereg/, bench/, or artifacts/ other than artifacts/review/ has changed, nor the Makefile, pyproject.toml, or uv.lock (`git diff --stat cec6701..73702ee` over those paths is empty), so every gate implementation and every banked artifact is as the reviews of cec6701 and faf22c5 examined them.

## What I ran and recomputed

- `python tools/ship_check.py --fast`, once, under nice, on a fresh clone of 73702ee: G1 PASS (4479 passed, 75 deselected; coverage 99.3%, every core module >= 85%); G2 PASS; G3 PASS (fast: its parts pass in G1, G2, G4); G4 PASS (0s offline under unshare -rn, matches golden, no model calls); G5 FAIL (artifacts/e0/claim_type_counts.json missing); G6 PASS (40 tasks; 1 run from a plan amendment, on the server it needs); G7, G8, G9 FAIL (no E1 or E4 artifacts); G10 PASS; G11 FAIL (no confirmatory artifact); G12 FAIL (the banked review is of faf22c5, and tests/ and docs/REVIEW_LOG.md changed since); G13 PASS (REPORT.md 7974 words); G14 PASS. SHIP-CHECK-FAST (does not count): 8/14, the eight gates that passed at cec6701 and two more than at faf22c5. Sub-command logs: claimcheck PASS (36 bound numbers in README.md, 45 in docs/REPORT.md), freshness PASS, reproduce PASS, citecheck PASS (8 references), prereg-verify PASS (frozen 0, drafts 3, confirmatory artifacts 0), secrets scan CLEAN (1903 tracked text files), budget OK (cash_usd = 0; 840 logged calls, all local, 135 of them cache hits; no Claude call; review cap effective 1).
- B9's test and the slow pilot validations, in a scratch clone of 73702ee with its own `uv sync --locked` environment: `pytest tests/bench/test_fakes.py tests/bench/test_validate.py -m 'slow or not slow'` gave 64 passed in 140 s, test_workspaces_are_removed_by_default and all four test_pilot_task_validates exemplars among them (pilot-py-bizdays included, the case N27 was about). No /tmp/receipts-fake-tmp-* directory existed before or after that run, nor after the main session's two prepush legs; the /tmp/receipts-bench-probe-*.tmp directories left at 09:23 are faf22c5's.
- The main session's prepush logs for 73702ee: "PREPUSH: PASS make ci on fresh clone of 73702ee..." with "311 exit 0" and "312 exit 0" (on success tools/prepush.sh prints only that line, so the logs give no test counts).
- Every bound smoke number, recomputed from the 40 banked run directories (run.json and verification.json) with my own script rather than tools/smoke_outcomes.py: 40 runs; 0 of 40 tasks done, Wilson [0.000, 0.088]; 39 reports; 15 claiming success (0.385, [0.249, 0.541]); 15 false successes; 15 of 15 success claims false ([0.796, 1.000]); 57 claims, 50 supported, 7 contradicted, 0 unverifiable; 10 of 15 false successes with no contradicted claim ([0.417, 0.848]); stop reasons 23 finished_at_cap, 16 finished, and 1 max_turns (the one run with no report); 20 Python and 20 TypeScript tasks; one model, seed 0, empty conditions, and mitigation none in every run; run.json and verification.json agree on every claim list and success flag, and the summary's 40 input hashes match the banked files. Hook latency from the 39 samples_s of artifacts/hook/latency.json: median 0.1767 s, maximum 0.2292 s (bound as 0.18 and 0.23); the hook code measured at 6d4a697 is unchanged at HEAD (only the tool's docstring changed). All equal artifacts/report/numbers.json, and the headline SVG's labels (0 of 40, 0.000 [0.000, 0.088]; 15 of 39, 0.385 [0.249, 0.541]) match.
- The run-by-run statements of docs/REPORT.md sections 7.2 to 7.4 and of the README's caught and missed examples, against the banked verdicts and ledgers: every tests_pass claim is supported (15 of 15); supported claims are mostly file_modified (17), tests_pass (15), could_not (10), and tests_added (4); the contradicted claims are 4 feature_implemented, 1 task_complete, and the tests_added and file_modified claims of ts-parser-tests; the four reports with no claim (py-ci-workflow, ts-state-machine, ts-todo-tags, the larger-window py-units-refactor), the five with only file claims (plus tests_added for py-lru-ttl and ts-parser-tests), py-vendored-semver with no claim, ts-emitter with only could_not, py-cli-json claiming success through a supported feature claim, and the false-success runs named for missed completion statements all hold. ts-parser-tests: eight agent npm test runs, no write, empty post-run diff. Larger-window py-units-refactor: its only edit returned an error, the post-run diff is empty, no claim was extracted, and seven failed hidden checks are listed as omissions.
- Demo fixtures: the three ledgers under tests/fixtures/recorded/demo/ are byte-identical to their banked runs, and each meta.json equals record_demo.fixture_meta(<banked run>) today.
- No em dash in any tracked UTF-8 file (literal or HTML entity); no hype word in any tracked file outside tests/ except the rule's own text (CLAUDE.md:29, docs/BUILD_BRIEF.md:195) and G13's pattern (tools/ship_check.py:82); no secret-shaped string in a tracked file outside tests/. The outbound launch draft binds both of its numbers (`tools/claimcheck.py outbound/launch-post-draft.md`: PASS).
- Leakage and preregistration: no E0, E1, or E4 artifact, no frozen preregistration, and no prereg/LOCK.json exist, so no held-out item, confirmatory run, or frozen file exists to be touched or pooled. prereg/0001-e1-main-study.md section 3 records that the G6 smoke runs (seed 0, every task) are never pooled with E1 or E4 data, and the planned pilot uses pilot-* tasks only (D41). The only intervals reported are Wilson intervals on the exploratory smoke runs, with their independence caveat in README.md (Limitations) and docs/REPORT.md sections 7.4 and 9.
- The checkout has its full history (not shallow; 256 commits to HEAD).

## Blocking

None.

## Resolved since the review of faf22c5

- B9: tests/bench/fakes.py:85-86 now makes each fake sandbox's private TMPDIR with tempfile.mkdtemp, outside the workspace and its parent, and removes it with weakref.finalize when the sandbox goes; tests/bench/test_fakes.py:12-26 checks that commands see it as TMPDIR, that it is not the host temp directory, that nothing lands in or beside the workspace, and that it is gone once the sandbox is collected. test_workspaces_are_removed_by_default passes in the fast check and in the scratch clone, both prepush legs pass, and G1 and G3 pass again, so STATUS.md:17 and :19, README.md:312-313, and docs/REPORT.md:674-679 are true at 73702ee.
- N27 stays fixed: the four slow pilot validations pass, and a task's pytest gets a pytest-of-<user> directory inside the private TMPDIR, never the host's /tmp/pytest-of-<user>.

## Still open, non-blocking

- N2 (new evidence): STATUS.md:28 says the review of cec6701 "returned SHIP with N27 and N28, both since fixed", and STATUS.md:29 speaks of "the commit that fixes N27 and N28", but N28's meta.json part is still open. STATUS.md is allowed drift.
- N3 (re-raised, new evidence): README.md:327-329 says `tools/prepush.sh` runs make setup and make ci on a fresh clone "once for each of Python 3.11 and 3.12"; the script (tools/prepush.sh:14) runs them once, on PY 3.11 unless the caller sets PY, and the 3.12 leg is a second run. e8ee5de had fixed this wording; fc89cc9 (2026-11-25) shortened it back. The practice is real; the sentence credits the script with it. A corrected sentence needs a CORRECTIONS.md entry.
- N13, N18, N19, N20, N21, N22, N23, N25, N26: unchanged, since no gate code, package code, or banked artifact changed after cec6701 (evidence in the nonblocking list).
- N24 (m) and (n): unchanged (docs/REPORT.md:589 against CORRECTIONS.md:134, :46, and :72; src/receipts/__init__.py:1 "check every claim").
- N28 (remaining part): unchanged; the card's labels and meta.json agree with the banked runs today.

## Notes

- Validity under D10: the reviewed commit is HEAD and every non-blocking id here is already listed in docs/REVIEW_LOG.md at 73702ee, so tools/review.py --validate-only accepts this review for 73702ee and for any commit that differs from it only in artifacts/review/, STATUS.md, or docs/LOG.md. Recording the N2 or N3 evidence in docs/REVIEW_LOG.md, or correcting README.md for N3, changes a file outside ALLOWED_DRIFT and then needs another review; section 10.6 step 2 commits only artifacts/review/. A subagent never declares a gate passed (section 10.4); only a full make ship-check does.
- Known and listed in STATUS.md, not raised again: the ledger writer serializes with ensure_ascii=False (src/receipts/ledger/events.py:234) while read_ledger splits with str.splitlines() (:365), so a U+2028, U+2029, or U+0085 in recorded output would make a ledger unreadable (an error, not a wrong verdict). No tracked JSON or JSONL file under artifacts/ or tests/fixtures/ contains any of them, so no reported number is affected.
- Checked and not an issue: G6 takes each task's reference result from the banked artifacts/bench/reference_validation.json (hidden_passed, bound to the current tree hash; banked by tools/bench_validate.py from 85f9b92 with bench_dirty false under bubblewrap) instead of running the 40 validations again. docs/REPORT.md section 4 and docs/BENCH.md section 10 say so, and section 10.1 step 9 has ship_check verify banked artifacts and recompute statistics rather than run them.
- This is the fifth subagent review on 2026-11-25. D20 (recorded 2026-10-23) and D75 read the claude_review_runs_per_day cap (effective 1 with cap_share 0.2) as metering headless review runs; whether section 10.1 step 8 means it to cover subagent reviews is for Raj to confirm, as the review of faf22c5 also noted.

## Verdict

No blocking issue is open at 73702ee; the open items above are non-blocking and already listed in docs/REVIEW_LOG.md.
REVIEW: SHIP
